title: Especialista em melhoria contínua - Jacareí
description:
RESUMO DO CARGO

Essa pessoa será responsável por promover a cultura de melhoria contínua nas operações, garantindo a padronização dos processos conforme os padrões globais.

Entre suas principais atividades estão o suporte ao planejamento e execução de treinamentos Belt (Lean Six Sigma), a identificação e lançamento de projetos de melhoria de diferentes níveis de complexidade, e o acompanhamento da governança dos projetos entre as plantas. Também será responsável por desenvolver processos de gestão e garantir que o AMPS esteja integrado à rotina operacional das fábricas, assegurando consistência e entrega de resultados.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  1. Suportar à implementação do AMPS (Ardagh Metal Production System) nas unidades de latas e tampas da Ardagh Metal Packaging, com o objetivo de disseminar a cultura de melhoria contínua nas áreas de operações, além da padronização do modelo aos padrões globais.
  2. Suportar o processo de planejamento, implementação e execução dos treinamentos de formação Belt, bem como o suporte na identificação e lançamento de novos projetos de baixa, média e alta complexidade, com o objetivo de garantir o alcance de resultados alinhados as metas da organização.
  3. Apoiar a coordenação corporativa do programa AMPS, por meio do acompanhamento da execução da implementação e governança dos Use Cases, com o objetivo de garantir o padrão de ferramentas e abordagens entre as plantas, aderência ao padrão global e entrega de resultados para a organização.
  4. Desenvolver e atuar em processos de governança e acompanhamento na gestão de ferramentas e processos do programa AMPS de forma a acompanhar sua implementação, incorporação da gestão de rotina das fábricas bem com aderência aos padrões.

Pré-Requisitos

  • Superior Completo, preferencialmente em Engenharia.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em:
  • Lean Manufacturing e Seis Sigma.
  • Gestão de Rotina.
  • Hoshin Kanri.
  • Metodologias de análise de falhas (A3/8D).
  • Gestão de projetos.
  • Black Belt Certificado.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Pacote Office
  • Sistema ERP: SAP
  • Disponibilidade para viagens

Sobre a Ardagh

A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. Globalmente, a AMP opera 24 instalações de produção nas Américas e Europa, empregando cerca de 5.800 funcionários e registrou receitas de US $ 4 bilhões em 2021. A inclusão, confiança, trabalho em equipe e excelência são nossos valores e junto com o talento que buscamos, serão a fórmula perfeita para crescermos juntos!

Somos apaixonados por sustentabilidade e temos uma ótima reputação pela inovação e qualidade que oferecemos a nossos clientes. Nós somos pioneiros em novos métodos de produção, novas técnicas de design e novas formas de reciclar e economizar energia. Nosso objetivo é reduzir os impactos ambientais, enquanto permanecemos economicamente sustentáveis e socialmente responsáveis.

Na Ardagh, temos a consciência da singularidade de cada ser humano. Valorizamos e respeitamos a diversidade da nossa rede de colaboradores. Aqui, você pode ser você, contribuindo com suas experiências para o nosso negócio. Afinal, cada um é um mundo, e, na Ardagh, todo mundo importa! Gostou? #VEM ser você :)

Se seu perfil corresponde à vaga, candidate-se a essa posição e #VEMserLateiroAMP.

title: Consultor(a) de Engenharia de Sistemas
description:
Convidamos você para se juntar à nossa equipe global de inovadores .

A Hexing está espalhada por mais de 90 países e somos uma empresa que valoriza a diversidade e a colaboração . Estamos contribuindo cada vez mais no desenvolvimento de tecnologias de energia verde para o desenvolvimento global, com foco em soluções inovadoras para um futuro sustentável .

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico com oportunidades de crescimento , desenvolvimento profissional contínuo e benefícios atraentes.

Aqui na Eletra Energy (empresa do Grupo Hexing no Brasil) você terá a chance de fazer a diferença, trabalhando em projetos impactantes que moldam o futuro . Se você é apaixonado por inovação e sustentabilidade, queremos você em nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!

Descrição da vaga:

  • Atuar como referência técnica em projetos de engenharia de sistemas, liderando definições de arquitetura, integrações e soluções técnicas complexas;
  • Garantir a aderência às boas práticas de engenharia, normas técnicas, requisitos regulatórios e padrões internos da organização;
  • Conduzir revisões técnicas, validações e decisões críticas de projeto junto às equipes multidisciplinares;
  • Orientar tecnicamente desenvolvedores, analistas e engenheiros, promovendo capacitação contínua e compartilhamento de conhecimento;
  • Participar ativamente na análise de requisitos, modelagem de sistemas e especificação de interfaces e componentes;
  • Liderar a definição de estratégias de testes, verificação e validação de sistemas;
  • Atuar como ponte entre áreas técnicas e áreas de negócio, traduzindo necessidades funcionais em soluções viáveis e sustentáveis;
  • Apoiar a gestão de projetos na estimativa de esforço, cronograma e mitigação de riscos técnicos;
  • Promover a melhoria contínua nos processos de engenharia e o uso eficiente de ferramentas e tecnologias;
  • Garantir a integridade técnica das entregas ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida do produto ou sistema.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa ou em andamento em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência consolidada em desenvolvimento de software e sistemas, com atuação prática em todo o ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento (análise, design, implementação, testes e manutenção);
  • Domínio de princípios de arquitetura de software e engenharia de sistemas, incluindo modularidade, escalabilidade, reutilização e manutenibilidade;
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em padrões de projeto (design patterns) e boas práticas de programação orientada a objetos e/ou funcional;
  • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de CI/CD (ex.: GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, pipelines automatizados, versionamento semântico);
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e/ou híbridas, com entendimento de ciclos iterativos e entrega contínua de valor;
  • Forte conhecimento em integração de sistemas, APIs (REST/SOAP), e comunicação entre microsserviços;
  • Capacidade de liderança técnica, mentoria de desenvolvedores e tomada de decisões arquiteturais estratégicas;
  • Habilidade para conduzir code reviews, definições técnicas e promover cultura de engenharia de alta qualidade;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de versionamento (Git), documentação técnica e gestão de backlog técnico;
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação e especificações de sistemas.

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Buscamos um Cientista de Dados Sênior com profundo foco em estatística e metodologia quantitativa para se juntar à nossa equipe. O profissional será responsável por liderar a aplicação de técnicas estatísticas robustas na análise de dados complexos, transformando grandes volumes de informação em insights estratégicos e modelos preditivos de alta precisão. Esta função é crucial para garantir a validade científica e a interpretabilidade de todas as nossas soluções de dados.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Modelagem Estatística: Projetar, desenvolver e validar modelos estatísticos (regressão, séries temporais, modelos lineares generalizados, etc.) e algoritmos de Machine Learning para resolver problemas de negócio complexos.
  • Análise Preditiva e Prescritiva: Liderar análises aprofundadas usando técnicas estatísticas para previsão de tendências, segmentação de clientes, otimização de processos e avaliação de risco.
  • Teste de Hipóteses e Experimentação (A/B Testing): Conduzir o design de experimentos (DOE) e realizar testes A/B rigorosos, aplicando testes de significância estatística para medir o impacto e a eficácia de novas funcionalidades ou estratégias.
  • Validação e Interpretabilidade: Garantir a validade estatística dos modelos e resultados, focando na interpretabilidade para que as descobertas sejam claramente comunicadas e acionáveis para as equipes de produto e executivas.
  • Manipulação e Limpeza de Dados: Trabalhar com big data , realizar ETL ( Extract, Transform, Load ) e garantir a qualidade dos dados utilizados nas análises.
  • Comunicação de Insights : Traduzir resultados estatísticos complexos em narrativas de negócio claras, utilizando visualizações de dados eficazes e relatórios detalhados para stakeholders não-técnicos.

Requisitos Essenciais

  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas quantitativas correlatas. Pós-graduação (Mestrado/Doutorado) em Estatística, Econometria ou Métodos Quantitativos é um diferencial.
  • Estatística Avançada: Domínio de métodos estatísticos, inferência, econometria, amostragem e teste de hipóteses.
  • Programação: Proficiência em Python ou R para análise de dados, estatística e desenvolvimento de modelos.
  • Bancos de Dados: Experiência com SQL para manipulação e extração de dados.
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência comprovada como Cientista de Dados ou em função quantitativa similar.

Habilidades Desejáveis

  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados ( Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio ).
  • Familiaridade com Deep Learning e modelos de linguagem ( LLMs ).

title: System Engineer
description:
Shape the Future of Automotive Technology with KPIT!

KPIT is a global leader in providing technology solutions and services to the automotive and mobility industries. We are expanding our team in Betim and seeking talented HIL Validation Engineers to join us. We are hiring for 4 positions at both Mid-Level (2-5 years of experience) and Advanced Level (5-9 years of experience). This is a Hybrid role with an 8.5-hour workday.

Role Overview:

As a HIL Validation Engineer, you will be responsible for the validation of Body domain ECUs using state-of-the-art dSPACE HIL systems. You will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our automotive software solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) validation for Body domain ECUs using dSPACE HIL systems (PHS/Scalexio).
  • Connect ECUs, sensors, and actuators to the LabCar environment; manage wiring harness and breakout box testing.
  • Commission HIL rigs and debug hardware/software integration issues.
  • Develop HIL test specifications, create test cases, procedures, and generate comprehensive test reports.
  • Automate HIL tests utilizing Python or CAPL scripting.
  • Analyze test failures and perform root cause analysis within the test environment.
  • Ensure compliance with Agile processes, the V&V lifecycle, and ASPICE standards.

Mandatory Skills:

  • Hands-on experience with dSPACE HIL hardware (ControlDesk, AutomationDesk, ConfigurationDesk).
  • Solid knowledge of CAN/LIN protocols, UDS services, and ECU diagnostics.
  • Familiarity with Vector tools: CANoe, CANalyzer, CANape for communication setup and analysis.
  • Strong debugging skills related to ECU functional software and the HIL environment.
  • Experience with test automation frameworks and scripting languages (Python/CAPL).
  • Experience with requirement management tools: DOORS, PREEVision.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in BCM (Body Control Module) validation or HVAC system testing.
  • Knowledge of CAN-FD, FlexRay, and Ethernet communication protocols.
  • Understanding of HIL simulator models (dSPACE) and ARXML models.
  • Exposure to multi-ECU HIL setups and integration testing.

Tools & Technologies:

  • dSPACE: ControlDesk, AutomationDesk, ConfigurationDesk.
  • Vector tools: CANoe, CANalyzer, CANape.
  • MATLAB/Simulink for plant modeling.
  • Requirement tools: DOORS, RTC.
  • Debugging tools: Trace32, Wireshark.

O que você precisa ter:

A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Gostou? Então vem com a gente.

title: Fullstack Engineer (Python)
description:
About the Opportunity:

We are hiring Fullstack Engineer (Python). You will play a key role in building and maintaining integrations within Veriff’s ecosystem, contributing to high-quality, secure, and reliable data processing pipelines. This role involves working with multiple external providers, complex REST APIs, and integrating with both monolithic and microservices architectures.

Responsibilities:

  • Build complete onboarding integrations from external data provider APIs into Veriff’s internal workflows.
  • Implement data normalization and transformation logic.
  • Develop connector implementations following Veriff’s Connector Hub standards.
  • Ensure production-grade quality, security, and reliability.
  • Implement REST API integrations, authentication (OAuth, API keys, custom), data mapping, error handling, and retry mechanisms.
  • Work on performance optimizations and rate limiting.
  • Collaborate with the internal Connector Hub team, providing feedback and suggesting improvements.
  • Work within existing monolithic and microservices architecture and integrate with RabbitMQ.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional experience with Python.
  • Strong command of Python (async, error handling, data structures).
  • Significant hands-on experience integrating REST APIs, working with 8+ different providers .
  • Expertise in data parsing, mapping, and transformation (JSON/XML parsing and manipulation).
  • Experience with RabbitMQ or other message-queue systems.
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, including production API issues.
  • Fast learner with the ability to understand and adapt to new vendor APIs.
  • Ability to write clear, concise technical documentation.

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience with multi-provider integrations .
  • Domain knowledge in identity verification, KYC, or fintech .
  • Understanding of the Latin American or European markets .

Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Especialista em Controladoria II
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Apoiar na aplicação das normas contábeis pertinentes aos negócios do grupo, garantindo conformidade societária e regulatória.
  • Elaborar memorandos técnicos para sustentação normativa das operações do Grupo Aegea.
  • Atuar em temas estratégicos (societários, jurídicos, novos negócios, planejamento e operações financeiras), assegurando conformidade contábil.
  • Suportar o time de auditoria em temas técnicos críticos e na elaboração das demonstrações financeiras de sustentabilidade conforme IFRS-S.
  • Acompanhar e controlar estruturas de ações preferenciais e o mapa de dividendos do grupo.
  • Participar da elaboração de relatórios financeiros de sustentabilidade, traduzindo riscos ambientais em impactos contábeis.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis com pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.
  • Registro ativo no CRC.
  • Experiência sólida com atuação técnica em contabilidade/controladoria.
  • Conhecimento em normas contábeis e capacidade de interpretação técnica.
  • Vivência em empresas dos segmentos de concessão e/ou infraestrutura.
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (nível intermediário).

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência com relatórios de sustentabilidade e normas IFRS-S.

Benefícios

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +800 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: UX Writer Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.

Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!

Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Híbrido
  • Localização: São Paulo — Butantã
  • Frequência: 1x por semana no escritório
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h, com jornada flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Entre 3 e 4 etapas, com prazo médio de até 3 dias úteis entre cada fase.
  • Meios de Comunicação: E-mail e WhatsApp — certifique-se de que seus dados estejam corretos no momento da inscrição.

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma UX Writer/Content Designer para fazer parte do nosso movimento. Essa pessoa será responsável por criar experiências conversacionais claras, humanas e alinhadas à marca, garantindo que o conteúdo seja um pilar estratégico da solução.

Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Definir voz, tom e personalidade do agente conversacional, mantendo atualizado o Guia de Estilo do Cliente.
  • Projetar fluxos de conversa (scripts, mensagens, fallback, redirecionamentos).
  • Escrever e revisar conteúdos como prompts, microcopy, mensagens do sistema e respostas do agente.
  • Traduzir posicionamento, valores e tom de voz da marca em experiências verbais consistentes ao longo de todos os pontos de contato do produto.
  • Colaborar com engenharia para estruturar intents, entidades, regras e integrações.
  • Criar documentações: guidelines, matriz de escalonamento, boas práticas e padrões conversacionais.
  • Utilizar IA generativa como aceleradora do processo criativo, realizando curadoria ética para validar, ajustar e humanizar conteúdos gerados por máquinas.
  • Monitorar métricas conversacionais, analisar logs e propor melhorias contínuas.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Produto, Design, Pesquisa e Engenharia para garantir que o conteúdo seja parte central da experiência.
  • Garantir consistência, clareza e segurança nas interações, considerando privacidade, compliance e boas práticas.
  • Mapear jornadas e fluxos de uso para identificar oportunidades e pontos críticos de comunicação.
  • Garantir acessibilidade do conteúdo, escrevendo de forma inclusiva, simples e orientada ao usuário.

Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Experiência como UX Writer, Content Designer ou Conversation Designer.
  • Portfólio com exemplos de fluxos conversacionais, microcopy e processos de escrita.
  • Domínio de escrita objetiva, clara, com voz e tom bem construídos.
  • Experiência prática com construção de chatbots ou agentes conversacionais (LLMs ou NLU tradicionais).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como Figma e plataformas de conversação (Dialogflow, Rasa, Botpress, MS Bot Framework ou equivalentes).
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar métricas e logs.
  • Boa colaboração com times de engenharia e produto.

Você irá se destacar se:

  • Experiência com LLMs: prompts, system messages e contenção de respostas.
  • Noções de NLU/ML (intents, entities, treinamento e avaliação).
  • Vivência com testes de usabilidade, especialmente testes de conversação.
  • Familiaridade com versionamento (Git) e processos de CI/CD aplicados a conteúdo.
  • Experiência prévia em squads ágeis.

O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+ ;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass ;
  • Seguro de vida.

Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo .

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Must-haves:

Day-to-Day:

In this role, you will support infrastructure operations for a suite of software products. Responsibilities include managing permissions, handling one-off requests via Slack, resolving access issues, and supporting releases for new services. You’ll be responsible for patching and maintaining cloud infrastructure, primarily in a Linux environment. You’ll use AWS (EC2, Security Groups) and Terraform to manage infrastructure as code, following established formats. Tasks also include scripting for deployment and collaborating with engineering teams to ensure smooth operations. Some exposure to Windows environments is acceptable, though the focus is on Amazon Linux.

Benefits Information – CLT

This is a CLT opportunity. You are eligible for 15 days annual holidays/sick time and 30 days annual time off. Benefits also include an FTGS contribution, social security contribution, and a meal voucher. Annual salary will be paid in local currency (REAL), and ranges based on years of experience and skillset. Full details on time off listed below. Medical/healthcare is NOT provided due to the public healthcare system.

EOR (CLT) in Brazil have all the statutory benefits:

  1. Meal Voucher
  2. Social Security
  3. Workers Compensation Insurance
  4. State Pension Fund

Paid Time Off

Both full-time and part-time employees are entitled to 30 calendar days of paid time off (PTO) a year. PTO accrues monthly at 2.5 days per month. Employees are eligible for annual leave after 1 year of work. During the first year of employment, an employee is not allowed to take any leave.

Apurar os impostos devidos, através de registros específicos em livros e guias, visando atender agenda fiscal e adimplência.

Preparar e elaborar relatórios gerenciais, realizando levantamentos de informações financeiros e andamento de trabalhos e resultados alcançados, visando a disponibilização de informações estratégicas para acompanhamento dos indicadores e tomada de decisão.

title: Game Operations Analyst/Senior Analyst (Graduated from 2022-2025)
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

Main Responsibility

Support the strategy and performance of digital game operations, ensuring an excellent player experience while contributing to product evolution and monetization.

Job Description

  • Assist in analyzing player behavior and game performance to suggest improvements in retention, engagement, and monetization.
  • Collaborate on planning in-game events, update cycles, and monetization strategies.
  • Monitor real-time data to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Work alongside product, marketing, and support teams to ensure smooth operations and timely content delivery.
  • Create reports and dashboards tracking key metrics.
  • Research industry benchmarks to support strategic decisions.
  • Present insights and recommendations to internal teams, turning data into actionable strategies across departments.

Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.
  • Drive: Unwavering commitment to overcoming obstacles and pushing boundaries to achieve your goals.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree completed or expected between December 2022 and December 2025 in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Digital Games or other fields
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Able to work in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote)
  • Able to work in a full-time position (8 hours per day)
  • Passionate about games
  • Knowledge in Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace (Word/Docs, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides)

Why Join Us

Join a dynamic team where you will be directly involved in high-impact strategic projects that shape the future of our games and brand. Benefit from personalized mentorship and continuous learning opportunities through close collaboration with our experienced management team. Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.

title: Procurement Engineer
description:
Greenlane Renewables Inc., headquartered in metro Vancouver, Canada, is driving change: accelerating the energy transition. We are cleaning up two of the largest and most difficult-to-decarbonize sectors of the global energy system: the natural gas grid and commercial transportation. As a pioneer and leading global specialist in biogas desulfurization and upgrading, we have been actively contributing to the decarbonization of our planet for over 35 years with more than 355 systems supplied into 28 countries. We transform biogas generated from organic waste into high-value grid-ready renewable natural gas (“RNG”) from a wide range of sources such as landfills, sugar mills, dairy farms, wastewater, and food waste. Greenlane is transforming energy production and creating new, sustainable revenue streams for its customers - all while dramatically reducing carbon emissions. Join us, let’s accelerate the energy transition together.

Greenlane is seeking a Procurement Engineer to bridge commercial purchasing with technical evaluation. This role ensures that procured mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation components meet engineering specifications, cost targets, and project requirements. Working closely with Engineering, Operations, Project Management, Supplier Quality, and Finance, this position supports global sourcing, supplier development, and procurement execution for complex engineered materials and equipment.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Identify and qualify suppliers for technical materials, engineered components, and sub-systems.
  • Review engineering drawings, BOMs, schematics, and specifications to ensure correct material and component selection.
  • Evaluate supplier technical capability, manufacturability, quality standards, and compliance.
  • Conduct proposal evaluations using both commercial and technical criteria.
  • Issue RFQs, manage bid analysis, and negotiate pricing, terms, warranties, and delivery.
  • Place purchase orders and manage changes, expediting, documentation, and delivery schedules.
  • Track goods receipts and resolve discrepancies.
  • Monitor supplier performance and drive corrective actions when quality, cost, or schedule issues arise.
  • Support supplier scorecards and performance review cycles.
  • Conduct due diligence and qualification for new suppliers.
  • Work closely with Engineering to clarify specifications and interpret drawings.
  • Interface with Operations, Project Management, and Quality for procurement planning and risk mitigation.
  • Provide procurement inputs for proposals, costing, and project plans.
  • Support cost-reduction, standardization, and value-engineering initiatives.
  • Contribute to internal process improvement projects.

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt or Lean certification preferred
  • 3–7 years of combined procurement, sourcing, engineering, or supply chain experience in a manufacturing or technical environment.
  • Experience reading engineering drawings and technical specifications is required.
  • Experience working with ERP systems (NetSuite preferred).
  • Experience with mechanical, electrical, or instrumentation components is preferred.
  • Experience with international sourcing and global supplier management is an asset.
  • Effective communicator who can interact with both technical (engineering) and commercial (suppliers, finance) stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of engineering drawings, BOM structures, and technical specifications.
  • Knowledge of supply chain best practices, sourcing strategies, and commercial purchasing processes.
  • Familiarity with quality control standards and regulatory requirements in manufacturing.

How to Apply

We are an equal opportunity employer and invite applications from all qualified individuals. To be considered for this role please apply through the Greenlane Renewables page on LinkedIn and attach your resume. While we thank all interested candidates only those who are short-listed will be contacted.

title: Product Owner
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree

FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields

EXPERIENCE;

  • At least 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.

COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments

CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES

Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
  • Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus

ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY

• Registro de todas as interações e entregas no sistema interno de gestão

• Noções sólidas de tributação de pessoas jurídicas.

Diferenciais

O profissional ideal eleva a maturidade financeira, acelera o ROI da implementação e cria capacidade analítica para suportar decisões tributárias estratégicas. Esta é uma posição de alto impacto direto no nível executivo dos clientes.

title: Manufacturing Engineering Supervisor
description:
Job Description:

The Manufacturing Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading all Engineering teams within the plant, ensuring flawless and successful product launches and robust high-volume production processes. This role provides both functional and disciplinary leadership to manufacturing engineers and process technicians, guaranteeing performance, quality, and continuous improvement across all manufacturing activities..

Key Responsibilities:

Leadership & Management

  • Provide functional and disciplinary leadership to the Manufacturing Engineering teams.
  • Oversee process technicians, ensuring alignment with plant goals and operational excellence.
  • Lead decision-making, strategic planning, resource allocation, and budgeting activities.
  • Monitor and control KPIs, define objectives, and ensure effective performance management and staff development.
  • Prepare and deliver regular reports to the Plant Manager.

Manufacturing Engineering

  • Lead Mechanical Engineering teams on all topics required to ensure program success from launch to mass production.
  • Ensure that robust, efficient, and safe production processes are implemented and sustained on the shop floor.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives following Mechanical Engineering standards, Lean methods, and EBOS principles.
  • Monitor process performance and ensure processes consistently deliver the expected results.

Engineering Change & Transfers

  • Own and manage local Engineering Change Management for product and process modifications, ensuring minimal impact on mass production lines.
  • Lead and oversee production transfers to and from the plant, ensuring seamless execution.

Quality & Customer Requirements

  • Ensure all customer requirements are met, including corrective and preventive actions.
  • Support product design and development activities to ensure compliance with manufacturing standards and process capabilities.

Requirements:

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or related fields.
  • Post-graduate degree or MBA in engineering, manufacturing, management, or related areas.

Experience & Technical Skills

  • Strong experience in manufacturing engineering within an industrial environment.
  • Advanced knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, and mechanical engineering applications in production.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams.
  • Experience with engineering change management (product and process).
  • Solid understanding of performance indicators, strategic planning, and budget management.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Inspirational, results-driven leadership.
  • Strong analytical and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent communication skills across all organizational levels.
  • Proactive, organized, and with a strong systems-thinking mindset.

title: IT Applications and Analytics Analyst LATAM
description:
Company Description

Red Bull gives wings to all people, to fly in whichever direction they want, respecting and tolerating the trajectory of each one, regardless of gender expression, race, religion, affective-sexual orientation, origin, age or disability. In the world of Red Bull, everyone is welcome.

The IT Application & Analytics analyst LATAM acts upon the global IT strategy, is responsible for the IT relevant coordination and communication of global business applications, their deployments within the area and head-coach regions, supporting demand process and service ownership for regional and local business applications.

Job Description

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· The IT Application & Analytics LATAM works thoroughly aligned with HQs BA service owners, HQ Data Team, BRMs and local peers of IT and business to ensure staying informed about relevant projects for counterparts in countries.

· The IT Application & Analytics analyst LATAM is responsible for service ownership and management of specific LATAM Analytics products.

· The IT Application & Analytics analyst LATAM is also responsible for assessing insights related demands from the different areas of the business (sales , logistics, marketing, etc), scoping the need and identifying the right technology together with it’s counterparts in LATAM or HQ. For the realization of analytics demands, the IT Application & Analytics analyst LATAM either relies on the skillset of other peers in the organization or will directly integrate and visualize data.

DEMAND CAPTURE & ALIGNMENT PROCESS SUPPORT

· Person acts as regional counterpart for Analytics requests.

· Capturing, scoping, documenting and prioritizing local demands (incl. HQ security or local privacy requirements).

· Thorough understanding of the underlying business case.

· Enabling the business-to-business communication.

· Ensuring a well-prepared and transparent decision process.

· Communication and explanation of taken decisions.

SUPPORTING SERVICE DELIVERY & PROJECTS

· Project oversight for global or regional projects.

· Project documentation and action plans on communication, training, handover, support.

· Stakeholder communication.

· Third Party Management.

· Satisfaction of business and users with new services or the operation throughout.

SUPPORTING SERVICE OWNERSHIP, OPERATION & CSI PROCESSES

· Service ownership for aligned and agreed regional services.

· Management and coordination of external support & development partners.

· Alignment with local and global service owners to ensure strategy fit of solutions.

· Alignment, development and maintenance of service roadmaps within the IT area.

· Ensure country requirements are communicated to global service owners.

· Regular review of operational KPIs to ensure insights on the service knowledge and performance are generated and improvement actions are derived.

ANALYTICS

· Assessing analytics demands from teams across the area LATAM.

· Performing user interviews to understand the different interests of the people involved.

· Analyzing the different data involved and their sources.

· Working with HQ Data committee to define a goal for the data visualization.

· Identifying data integration options, methods and technology.

· Aligning the approach with decision makers in the area LATAM and HQ.

· Support the realization process through externals or realization autonomously depending on the topic and the skill set.

· Closing demands ensuring success.

· Documenting and managing analytics use cases throughout their lifecycle.

Qualifications

Degree in computer science, business informatics or equivalent experience.

Strong communicator and relator, solid and broad business process understanding.

Project Management experience, ITIL knowhow beyond theory.

Team-oriented, self-driven and motivated personality, hands-on and flexible, thinking from the end.

Ability to understand complex and different types of requirements and translate those into technical concepts.

Excellent skills to interact with all levels of employees/executives.

Precise, systematic, accuracy and structured way of working.

Performance and result orientation.

Spoken and written English mandatory, Spanish a plus.

Strong mathematical skills to help collect, measure, organize and analyze data.

Interest or experience on working with analytics skills, such as data management and visualization.

Technical proficiency regarding database design development, data models, techniques for data mining and segmentation.

title: Price and Promotion Consulting and Implementation Manager
description:
dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, partnering with the world’s most ambitious retailers and brands to put the customer at the heart of every decision. We combine deep insight, advanced technology, and close collaboration to help our clients grow, innovate, and deliver measurable value for their customers.

dunnhumby employs nearly 2,500 experts in offices throughout Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Americas working for transformative, iconic brands such as Tesco, Coca-Cola, Nestlé, Unilever and Metro.

We are looking for Price and Promotion Consulting and Implementation Manager who can apply technology to promote the success of our retail clients while addressing business requirements through workflow design, configuring software for optimal client results, and conducting training in accordance with best practices. The Price and Promotion consulting and implementation manager will lead the deployment of dunnhumby’s P&P solutions to new and existing clients. They will work closely with the client’s teams to understand their requirements and ensure that our tools are fit for purpose.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the delivery of P&P Products: Ensure the timely and successful delivery of price and promotion software solutions that meet client’s needs and objectives, in line with the project plan. Analyse large and complex datasets to identify potential gaps and inconsistencies during the deployment process.
  • Drive Change: Develop and maintain trusted advisor relationships with client teams, guiding them through change by implementing new price and promotional processes. Work closely with the product teams to influence the roadmap based on clients’ feedback and develop new features collaboratively.
  • Process & Requirements Documentation: Understand and document the client’s current processes, identify and organize their business and process requirements, and work with the Price & Promotion Consulting Director and the wider team to recommend best-in-class solutions.
  • Software Configuration & Testing: Configure enterprise price and promotions software to align with specific client processes and needs. Develop and implement internal and external testing processes. Perform testing and analysis of data to ensure accuracy and effectiveness of software solutions.
  • GO Live support: Contribute to the successful execution of the GO Live phase by demonstrating the tool’s added value to the client. This involves organizing and participating in client sessions, conducting category analysis, proposing optimal solutions, and monitoring progress through measurement, reporting, and activity tracking.

Required Experience

  • Extensive experience working at a retailer/ FMCG within the Merchandising space and in enterprise software implementations. Specific expertise in Price and Promotions solutions desirable
  • A college degree or equivalent professional experience required
  • Strong business analysis and data analytics skills. Data visualization, advanced Microsoft Excel, programming language a plus
  • Support pre-sales activities and lead generation in coordination with Sales and Client teams to ensure the proper positioning of our P&P solutions to meet clients’ needs.
  • Experience in project management and workflow optimization

What you can expect from us

We won’t just meet your expectations. We’ll defy them. So you’ll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you’d expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.

You’ll also benefit from an investment in cutting-edge technology that reflects our global ambition. But with a nimble, small-business feel that gives you the freedom to play, experiment and learn.

And we don’t just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. Please let us know how we can make this process work best for you.

Our approach to Flexible Working

At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.

We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor

Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
Sobre a Assetway

Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia especializada em Gestão de Ativos Digitais (DAM) . Nosso foco é atender empresas que buscam uma solução mais eficiente e personalizada para organizar seus arquivos digitais (imagens, vídeos e documentos). Oferecemos inteligência, usabilidade e eficiência para estruturar, organizar e valorizar esses ativos.

O que você vai fazer por aqui

Você atuará na linha de frente com os nossos clientes, desde conversas iniciais, passando pela implementação da plataforma até suporte técnico e o acompanhamento contínuo de toda a jornada de uso.

Sua responsabilidade principal será garantir a utilização, adoção plena e a obtenção do valor máximo da nossa plataforma por parte do cliente. Para isso, você oferecerá suporte proativo e customizado, além de treinamentos e orientações práticas, sempre alinhados aos desafios e à rotina operacional de cada organização.

Um cenário típico é uma empresa que usa Google Drive para organizar os arquivos digitais, em pastas. Seu foco será ajudar o cliente a migrar este acervo para a Assetway, fazer com que eles usem todos os recursos da maneira certa, garantir que estão satisfeitos com a plataforma e prestar suporte contínuo, próximo e personalizado.

title: Remote Sales Project Coordinator- Full-Time (UTS Group)
description:
Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time

Company: UTS Group

*Only Resumes in English will be considered*

About the Role

UTS Group is seeking a highly organised, confident, and proactive Sales Project Coordinator to support our sales department from start to finish. The ideal candidate is not afraid to make decisions , can manage multiple moving parts at once, and thrives in a structured, fast-paced environment.

This role ensures sales opportunities flow smoothly into well-coordinated projects—managing communication, documentation, scheduling, and follow-ups while supporting both our clients and internal teams.

This is a 100% full-remote position , requiring discipline, ownership, and strong communication.

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales Support & Opportunity Management

  • Assist sales representatives by coordinating all project details from inquiry to proposal
  • Prepare quotes, proposals, supporting documents, and client communications
  • Review project scopes to ensure clarity, accuracy, and completeness
  • Track sales pipeline activities and follow-ups through CRM

2. Project Coordination & Scheduling

  • Develop project timelines, schedules, and task lists
  • Coordinate with operations, technicians, vendors, and subcontractors
  • Monitor project progress and proactively resolve delays
  • Ensure materials, equipment, and resources are prepared on time

3. Communication & Client Coordination

  • Provide clear updates to clients regarding project status, schedules, and next steps
  • Translate technical details into simple, understandable information
  • Maintain positive client relationships and support repeat business
  • Act as the communication link between sales, operations, vendors, and clients

4. Documentation & Organisation

  • Organise and maintain all project files, documentation, and communication history
  • Prepare change orders, reports, close-out packages, and audit-ready records
  • Ensure all documents meet the company’s quality and compliance standards

5. Financial & Administrative Support

  • Assist with budgeting, cost estimates, procurement, and tracking expenses
  • Review vendor pricing, purchase orders, and order confirmations
  • Support sales in controlling project profitability and margins

6. Risk Management & Problem Solving

  • Identify inconsistencies in scopes, drawings, or client requirements
  • Flag risks early and recommend solutions before issues impact the project
  • Resolve conflicts or misalignment between teams or contractors

7. Leadership & Ownership

  • Take initiative and make decisions independently when needed
  • Keep team members accountable for deadlines and deliverables
  • Maintain a high-standard workflow with strong attention to detail

Must-Have Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in project coordination, sales coordination, or operations support
  • Experience in security, construction, low-voltage, service, or technical project environments
  • Proven ability to read and interpret proposals, schedules, and basic project documentation
  • Strong decision-maker who can work independently and confidently
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High-level organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple active tasks
  • Strong experience using:
  • Office 365 (Excel, Outlook, OneDrive, Word)
  • CRM systems (Zoho CRM, Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.)
  • Project management tools (Asana, Monday.com, Smartsheet, etc.)
  • Ability to work full-time from home with strong discipline and accountability

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience coordinating low-voltage, security, door hardware, or installation-related projects
  • Background in quoting, preparing proposals, or reviewing scopes of work
  • Familiarity with procurement, material ordering, and vendor relations
  • Understanding of construction workflows, site coordination, and scheduling
  • Strong documentation and reporting skills
  • Experience handling change orders, budgets, and cost tracking

Who You Are

  • Extremely organised , structured, and detail-driven
  • Comfortable making decisions without waiting for direction
  • Able to communicate clearly with clients, teams, suppliers, and technicians
  • Calm, professional, and solution-oriented under pressure
  • A strong multitasker who thrives in a remote environment
  • Someone who takes ownership and doesn’t let things fall through the cracks

Why Join UTS Group

  • 100% remote role with stable weekday schedule
  • Work with one of the most respected security and automation providers in North America
  • Growth-focused environment with opportunity to advance
  • Supportive leadership and well-defined workflows
  • Competitive compensation and benefits

title: Facilities Manager
description:
MISSION

Lead and oversee all Facilities operations across Corporate Offices, R&D Labs, Manufacturing Plant, and Distribution Center, ensuring safe, efficient, compliant, and cost-effective infrastructure. Drive operational excellence through strong vendor management, robust maintenance programs, and continuous improvement. Act as the key connection between local operations and global standards for EHS, Engineering, and Sustainability.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Ensure a safe work environment by promoting a strong safety culture and full compliance with legal requirements, NRs, company HSE policies, and global corporate standards.
  • Guarantee the integrity, reliability, and availability of all facilities infrastructure, including utilities, HVAC, electrical systems, water treatment, fire protection, building automation, and critical assets.
  • Lead, develop, and oversee internal and outsourced teams (maintenance, cleaning, security, reception, gardening, cafeteria, and services).
  • Manage preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance programs, ensuring uptime and operational continuity for Office, R&D Labs, Manufacturing, and Distribution Center.
  • Oversee facilities services to ensure high service levels, cost efficiency, and adherence to SLAs.
  • Lead improvement initiatives to enhance energy efficiency, sustainability, waste reduction, and operational performance.
  • Ensure compliance with certifications, internal audits, external audits, and global standards (ISO, GMP where applicable).
  • Oversee space planning, workplace strategy, building layout updates, and occupancy optimization.
  • Manage construction projects, renovations, expansions, and infrastructure modifications from planning to delivery, ensuring alignment with Capex governance.
  • Coordinate incident management, emergency response plans, fire brigade activities, and building security protocols.
  • Monitor and manage facilities KPIs, identifying root causes and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
  • Manage Opex and Capex budgets, ensuring cost optimization and adherence to financial targets.
  • Collaborate with key internal stakeholders (Manufacturing, R&D, Supply Chain, HR, IT, Security, Finance) to ensure seamless and compliant operations.
  • Ensure vendor management excellence, including contract negotiation, performance monitoring, compliance, and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for facilities matters with local leadership and global functional teams.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical), Architecture, Business Administration, or related fields.
  • Experience managing Facilities operations across multi-site or complex environments (Office, Industrial, Logistics, or R&D).
  • Minimum of 5 years of proven leadership experience in maintenance, utilities, infrastructure, or facilities services.
  • Strong technical background in building systems (HVAC, electrical, utilities, fire systems).
  • Demonstrated experience in maintenance management, vendor management, and project leadership.
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements (NRs), engineering standards, and EHS.
  • Proven experience in managing Capex and Opex budgets.
  • Experience in multinational environments is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced English is mandatory.

SOFT SKILLS

  • Ownership mindset, with strong presence in operations and a hands-on approach.
  • High level of discipline, organization, and operational rigor.
  • Intellectual curiosity and continuous learning mindset.
  • Agile, creative, and solution-oriented profile.
  • Strong critical thinking and ability to anticipate risks.
  • Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams with engagement and accountability.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

Resilience and ability to deliver impactful results under pressure.

title: Business Analyst
description:
THE ROLE

Love building things fast and figuring out what works? Curious about AI and excited to push the boundaries of what's possible? We're looking for a Business Analyst to join our Strategy team. You'll be our rapid prototyper---turning ideas into working features, testing what resonates, and handing off polished concepts to engineering for the full build. It's part builder, part thinker, and a whole lot of experimentation.

You'll work directly with the VP of Strategy and collaborate across product, engineering, and AI teams to bring new features to life quickly. If you're resourceful, creative, and love the thrill of "let's just try it and see," you'll thrive here.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build fully functioning feature prototypes using AI tools like Claude Code and our platform
  • Test, iterate, and refine ideas with real users before they hit full production
  • Work backwards from customer problems to design solutions that actually solve them
  • Collaborate with engineers to hand off working prototypes for implementation
  • Stay curious about AI capabilities and explore creative ways to leverage them

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • A knack for figuring things out---you don't need to know code, but you're not afraid to tinker
  • Strong product intuition and a bias toward action over perfection
  • Experience building, prototyping, or problem-solving in scrappy environments
  • Excellent communication skills---you can explain what you built and why it matters
  • Genuine interest in AI and emerging tools (exposure is a plus, enthusiasm is a must)
  • Bonus points for finance experience, but not required
  • Bonus points if you've worked with automation tools, no-code platforms, or AI assistants

Why Street Diligence?

We're The Deal Nerds making sense of complex contracts so our clients don't have to. But we're also builders who believe the best way to know if something works is to build it and test it. We move fast, we experiment often, and we're not afraid to try the unconventional approach. If you love the zero-to-one phase and want to shape how AI transforms financial intelligence, come join the crew.

title: Cientista de Dados Pleno
description:
A Privacy é a maior rede social de conteúdo digital da América Latina. Nascemos para conectar tecnologia ao poder criativo das pessoas. Somos um organismo vivo, onde cada pessoa é uma célula pulsante de abundância, liberdade e autorrealização.

Aqui, performance tem propósito, estrutura tem calor humano e ambição anda junto com ética.

Nosso produto é uma rede social líder no Brasil de monetização de conteúdo, em plena expansão internacional. Esse crescimento exige um(a) Cientista de Dados Pleno com mentalidade analítica, autonomia e capacidade de transformar dados em decisões estratégicas e modelos preditivos de impacto real no negócio.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar em todo o ciclo de vida de projetos de Data Science , desde a compreensão do problema até a entrega de modelos em produção;
  • Realizar exploração, limpeza e preparação de dados (Data Wrangling) para uso em análises e modelagem;
  • Desenvolver, validar e manter modelos de Machine Learning (regressão, classificação, clustering e séries temporais);
  • Executar análises estatísticas e testes de hipótese (ex: A/B Testing) para validar insights e estratégias;
  • Construir visualizações e relatórios claros e eficazes para comunicação de resultados;
  • Atuar em parceria com times de produto, engenharia e negócios , traduzindo achados técnicos em ações práticas;
  • Participar ativamente da construção de uma cultura orientada a dados , contribuindo com boas práticas e padronizações;
  • Acompanhar o desempenho dos modelos em produção , garantindo melhoria contínua e rastreabilidade.

O que valorizamos

Raciocínio analítico e curiosidade intelectual: pessoas que questionam, testam hipóteses e buscam compreender profundamente o problema antes de propor soluções.

Foco em impacto: profissionais que entendem o “porquê” por trás dos modelos e direcionam seus esforços para gerar valor real para o negócio.

Autonomia e colaboração: capacidade de conduzir projetos de ponta a ponta, em parceria com engenheiros de dados e áreas de produto.

Comunicação clara: traduzir resultados técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos de forma acessível e objetiva.

Inovação contínua: curiosidade para aprender novas ferramentas e aplicar novas técnicas de ciência de dados e IA.

Requisitos

  • Domínio de Python e suas principais bibliotecas de Data Science (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn);
  • Experiência sólida com SQL para extração, manipulação e análise de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Conhecimento prático em Machine Learning aplicado (regressão, classificação, clustering, séries temporais);
  • Base sólida em estatística e testes de hipóteses ;
  • Habilidade em visualização de dados (Matplotlib, Seaborn, Power BI ou equivalentes);
  • Familiaridade com o ciclo de vida completo de projetos de Data Science (da coleta ao monitoramento de modelos);
  • Boas práticas de código e programação orientada a objetos (POO) ;

title: Director of Salesforce Implementation
description:
Position Overview

The Director of Salesforce Implementation will lead a team of up to 15 Salesforce professionals across the US and LATAM, including consultants, developers, administrators, solution architects, and marketing automation specialists (MCAE and MCE). This role is responsible for project delivery excellence, ensuring projects are scoped accurately, executed effectively, delivered on time, and aligned with client expectations and IMG quality standards. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce expertise with proven team leadership, project governance, delivery operations, and client relationship skills. This director will serve as the operational leader of the implementation team, optimizing processes, reviewing time and utilization, providing coaching, managing escalations, and driving exceptional customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership and Management

  • Lead and mentor a cross-functional Salesforce implementation team across US and LATAM.
  • Provide coaching, one-on-ones, growth planning, and performance management.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and high-quality delivery.
  • Manage staffing, capacity planning, and resource allocation across all active projects.

Project and Delivery Oversight

  • Oversee all Salesforce implementation projects including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (MCAE), Marketing Cloud Engagement (MCE), and integrations.
  • Conduct regular project reviews to ensure progress, scope alignment, and adherence to timelines.
  • Monitor time tracking, utilization, and project budgets; identify trends and address over-burn or under-delivery risks.
  • Establish and refine delivery processes, best practices, and standard operating procedures.

Quality Control and Customer Satisfaction

  • Ensure projects meet IMG quality standards and deliver measurable business value.
  • Provide strategic oversight and intervention on escalations or complex project challenges.
  • Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive communication and alignment.
  • Partner with the Sales team during handoff to ensure a smooth transition from scoping to delivery.

Operational Excellence

  • Develop and maintain predictable implementation workflows and project governance frameworks.
  • Improve reporting and tracking across project health, timelines, scope changes, and team utilization.
  • Implement delivery tools, templates, documentation standards, and internal QA processes.
  • Collaborate with leadership on forecasting, hiring needs, and Salesforce practice growth.

Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams to ensure alignment across the client lifecycle.
  • Participate in internal strategic planning, service-offering refinement, and productization of Salesforce packages such as Jumpstart.
  • Support revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities during implementation.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7 or more years of Salesforce implementation experience (consulting or client-side).
  • 3 or more years leading technical or consulting teams, preferably remote or geographically distributed.
  • Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and marketing automation platforms (MCAE and MCE).
  • Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects and large-scale client engagements.
  • Experience with resource planning, time tracking, utilization reporting, and delivery KPIs.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Ability to operate at both the strategic and tactical levels.

Preferred

  • Salesforce certifications.
  • Experience at a Salesforce partner agency or professional services organization.
  • Background with project management tools such as Asana, Monday, or Wrike.
  • Experience with US, LATAM, and offshore team management.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and performance bonus structure.
  • Flexible remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to lead a rapidly expanding Salesforce practice.
  • Supportive leadership and a culture focused on growth, innovation, and client success.
  • Professional development opportunities and Salesforce certification support.
  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and emphasis on work-life balance.

title: Executivo de Vendas Externas - Máquina de cartão - Mercado Pago - MG
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!

Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.

Requisitos:

  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH "B” e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de atuação.

Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Analista de Exportação Sênior
description:
Nosso parceiro é uma empresa global, líder em soluções de limpeza, reconhecida por sua tecnologia, inovação e excelência operacional. Como parceira, se destaca pela solidez, pela visão estratégica de longo prazo e pelo compromisso com qualidade em cada etapa do processo. Com presença em mais de 80 países, a empresa promove práticas sustentáveis, desenvolvimento contínuo e relações comerciais baseadas em confiança, clareza e resultados.

Como Analista de Exportação , você será responsável por:

  1. Gerenciamento e atendimento do ciclo completo do pedido para subsidiárias Intercompany e Dealers desde o recebimento até conclusão da entrega;
  2. Ponto focal da subsidiária designada para pedidos, disponibilidade de material, tempo de entrega, preços, questões de logística, rastreamento de remessa, reclamações e questões de faturamento;
  3. Realizar reuniões periódicas para alinhamento dos pedidos e embarques;
  4. Conduzir o planejamento de embarques com o cliente e preparar os documentos de acordo com os procedimentos;
  5. Organizar o transporte junto aos prestadores de serviços (agentes de cargas, transportadora e despachante) e acompanhar o embarque até o destino final;
  6. Realizar estimativa e cotação de fretes, BIDs com agentes de carga, avaliando junto ao cliente o melhor custo e lead time;
  7. Conferência e lançamento de faturamento dos prestadores de serviços;
  8. Ser uma pessoa organizada, flexível, ágil e com foco no atendimento ao cliente;

O que esperamos que você traga na bagagem:

  • Necessário superior completo em Logística, Comércio Exterior, Relações Internacionais ou áreas correlatas
  • Necessário Inglês e Espanhol Avançados
  • Necessário experiência em Exportação ou Atendimento ao Cliente
  • Conhecimento em SAP (módulo SD) será um diferencial

Por que essa vaga é especial:

Porque aqui, você não apenas exporta — você conecta o Brasil ao mundo.

Seu trabalho garante que pedidos fluam com precisão, que clientes globais sejam atendidos com excelência e que cada embarque represente confiança, agilidade e profissionalismo.

É uma posição estratégica, onde organização, comunicação e visão global transformam entregas em experiências — e desafios em oportunidades.
